items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: I guess Joe wrote it, Joe just took it down as I wrote it

ctx.x: And the strange thing about this jazz, I used to go to the Crest stores and play the piano there, you know, and sell these records and play other numbers too, of course. But lots of people couldn't, they couldn't play this triangle jazz. It was too difficult for them. So I didn't make any money. Someday You Want Me. That was on a record. I made a little money out of that. But Triangle Jazz Blues did the cell because people figured it was too difficult. I guess Joe wrote it, Joe just took it down as I wrote it,…
Maybe Betty could run and get the record if the balance is okay now. And someday.
